symbiotebody.title: Symbiote
symbiotebody.description: The symbiote that has bonded with you.

symbiotebond1.title: Symbiote Bond Level 1
symbiotebond1.description: The symbiote grows attached to you, and begins helping outside of battle.

symbiotebond2.title: Symbiote Bond Level 2
symbiotebond2.description: The bond runs deep: the symbiote shields you with its own body.

venomswim.title: null
venomswim.description: The symbiote swims three times faster than a human.

noknockback.title: null
noknockback.description: In berserk or rage the symbiote cannot be pushed back.

enablesymbiotebody.title: Symbiote Takeover
enablesymbiotebody.description: Let the symbiote take over your body.

attackbarragedefaultaoedmg.title: Attack Barrage Area Damage
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored] run damage @s 10 minecraft:generic by @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1]

attackbarragewhipaoedmg.title: Whip Barrage Area Damage
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored] run damage @s 9 minecraft:generic by @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1]

attackbarrageaxeaoedmg.title: Axe Barrage Area Damage
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored] run damage @s 14 minecraft:generic by @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1]

attackbarragemaceaoedmg.title: Mace Barrage Area Damage
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored] run damage @s 12 minecraft:generic by @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1]

crushinggrip.title: Crushing Grip
crushinggrip.description: Seize a foe in both hands and crush it.

spikeburstdamage.title: Spike burst damage
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored] run damage @s 35 minecraft:generic by @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1]

spikeburstknockback.title: Spike burst knockback
commands: execute at @s as @e[distance=0.1..6,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored,type=!minecraft:player] facing entity @p[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1] feet run tp @s ^ ^ ^-0.8

hardenedhide.title: Hardened Hide
hardenedhide.description: The symbiote hardens around you and absorbs the impact of blows.

thickflesh.title: Thick Flesh
thickflesh.description: The symbiote thickens your flesh, raising your health.

thickflesh2.title: Thick Flesh II
thickflesh2.description: The symbiote thickens your flesh further.

symbiotestride.title: Symbiote Stride
symbiotestride.description: The symbiote carries you faster and further.

symbiotestride2.title: Symbiote Stride II
symbiotestride2.description: The symbiote carries you faster and further still.

combatwheel.title: Combat Tool Wheel
combatwheel.description: Choose the shape the symbiote takes in combat.

enablesymbiotehead.title: Symbiote Head
enablesymbiotehead.description: Grow the symbiote head, which feeds on its own when hunger runs low.

legcoverjump.title: Springing Legs
legcoverjump.description: Symbiote legs soften every landing and push you higher.

assimilate.title: Regeneration
assimilate.description: Feed on a nearby creature to heal the symbiote.
first_tick_commands: execute as @e[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1,type=!minecraft:player,type=!#klyntars:aoe_ignored,tag=!venom_feed_target] run tag @s add venom_feed_target
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b}
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 3 3 true
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:saturation 1 0 true
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run playsound klyntars:ability.assimilate player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.8 0.7
commands: execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 1 3 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] at @p[tag=venom_feeding,sort=nearest,limit=1] anchored eyes run tp @s ^ ^1 ^0.25
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:invisibility 1 0 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:slowness 1 255 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:weakness 1 255 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b}
last_tick_commands: execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:saturation 1 0 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..16,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:0b,NoGravity:0b}

enablevenomtentacles_traversal.title: TentaclesTraversal
enablevenomtentacles_traversal.description: Raise symbiote arms that carry you above the ground.
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s Venom.TentaclesTraversal matches 1 run tag @s add venom_tentacles_traversal_was_active
execute if entity @s[tag=venom_tentacles_traversal_was_active] run scoreboard players set @s Venom.TentaclesTraversal 0

enablevenomflight.title: Symbiote Flight
enablevenomflight.description: Spread the symbiote wings and take to the air.

fendoffenemies.title: Fend Off Enemies
fendoffenemies.description: The symbiote lashes at nearby enemies on its own.

grabtentacle.title: Grab Tentacle
grabtentacle.description: Seize a target with a tendril and hold it in front of you.

grabtentaclepush.title: Push Away
grabtentaclepush.description: Push the held target further away.

venomhungerabilitycost3.title: Symbiote Hunger Ability Cost 3
commands: execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 3.. run scoreboard players remove @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 3
execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 1..2 run scoreboard players set @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 0

venomhungerabilitycost10.title: Symbiote Hunger Ability Cost 10
commands: execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 10.. run scoreboard players remove @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 10
execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 1..9 run scoreboard players set @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 0

venomhungerabilitycost.title: Symbiote Hunger Ability Cost
commands: execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 1.. run scoreboard players remove @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 1

symbiontpull.title: Symbiont Pull
symbiontpull.description: Tendrils seize nearby foes, lift them high and slam them into the ground.

symbiotestrike.title: Symbiote Strike
symbiotestrike.description: Ride the tendrils upward, then dash through everything ahead of you.

ragemode.title: Rage Mode
ragemode.description: Unleash the symbiote's fury for twenty seconds.

symbioteblast.title: Symbiote Blast
symbioteblast.description: Detonate the symbiote twice in quick succession.

venombond3.title: Symbiote Bond Level 3
venombond3.description: The bond is complete. The symbiote holds nothing back.

knullsbond.title: Knull's Bond
knullsbond.description: Knull's legacy. The symbiote learns to carry you through the air.
